model.name: qwen3.6-35b-a3b (agent)
model.about: Alibaba Qwen3.6, mixture of experts (35B, about 3B active), FP8 as published by Qwen. Apache-2.0. Fits an A100 (about 44 GB of 80; FP8 through vLLM's fallback path there). Tests speed against the 27B dense Qwen: far fewer active parameters per token. Thinking off, as for the other Qwen profiles.

answers.sql:
SELECT
  d.CAL_YR_NBR,
  ch.DSPLY_NM AS channel_name,
  COUNT(*) AS txn_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL ch ON f.CHNL_K = ch.CHNL_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR, ch.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY d.CAL_YR_NBR, txn_count DESC

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS active_customers
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE IS_CURR = true
  AND IS_ACTV = true

SELECT 
    j.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction_name,
    COUNT(*) AS alert_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR j ON f.JUR_K = j.JUR_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY j.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY alert_count DESC

SELECT
  br.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name,
  COUNT(*) AS atm_txn_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR br ON f.BR_K = br.BR_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND br.IS_CURR = true
GROUP BY br.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY atm_txn_count DESC;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS dispute_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT dc.bus_id) AS num_clients_in_default
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.bus_dt_k = d.dt_k
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST dc ON f.cust_k = dc.cust_k
WHERE d.cal_dt = '2025-08-31'
  AND f.dflt_flg = true
  AND dc.is_curr = true

SELECT
    ctg.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category,
    COUNT(*) AS complaint_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG ctg ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = ctg.CMPLT_CTG_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY ctg.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY complaint_count DESC

SELECT
  d.CAL_YR_NBR,
  f.CCY_CD1,
  AVG(f.AVRG_RT) AS avg_daily_fx_rate
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
  ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR, f.CCY_CD1
ORDER BY d.CAL_YR_NBR, f.CCY_CD1

SELECT
  m.DSPLY_NM AS market_name,
  d.CAL_YR_NBR AS calendar_year,
  d.MTH_NM AS month_name,
  SUM(f.MKT_VAL1_AMT) AS total_portfolio_value
FROM bank_dwh.F_PTF_VAL_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_MKT m ON f.MKT_K = m.MKT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY
  m.DSPLY_NM,
  d.CAL_YR_NBR,
  d.MTH_NM
ORDER BY
  d.CAL_YR_NBR,
  d.MTH_NBR,
  m.DSPLY_NM;

SELECT ACCT_TYP_CD1, COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS account_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_ACCT
WHERE IS_CURR = true
  AND OPND_DT >= '2025-01-01'
  AND OPND_DT < '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY ACCT_TYP_CD1
ORDER BY ACCT_TYP_CD1;

SELECT b.CTY_NM AS branch_city, COUNT(*) AS atm_txn_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR b ON f.BR_K = b.BR_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND d.QTR_NBR = 1
  AND b.IS_CURR = true
GROUP BY b.CTY_NM
ORDER BY b.CTY_NM

SELECT
  AVG(f.CLSNG_BAL_AMT) AS avg_closing_balance
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f
WHERE f.BUS_DT_K = 20250630;

SELECT
  AVG(f.MID_RT) AS avg_mid_rate
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE f.CCY_CD1 = 'USD'
  AND d.MTH_NBR = 12
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025

SELECT
  d.MTH_NBR,
  COUNT(*) AS dispute_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR
ORDER BY d.MTH_NBR

SELECT
    CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS customer_segment,
    COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE IS_CURR = true
GROUP BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1
ORDER BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1;

WITH customers_with_txn AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ft.CUST_K
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN ft
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON ft.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
      AND ft.CUST_K IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.BUS_ID) AS customers_with_no_txn_in_2025
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST c
WHERE c.IS_CURR = true
  AND c.BUS_ID NOT IN (
      SELECT c2.BUS_ID
      FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST c2
      JOIN customers_with_txn cwt ON c2.CUST_K = cwt.CUST_K
      WHERE c2.IS_CURR = true
  );

SELECT
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN a.PMT_STS_CD1 = 'DECLINED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS declined_pct
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH a
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT
    cat.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category_name,
    COUNT(*) AS escalated_complaints
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG cat ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = cat.CMPLT_CTG_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND f.IS_ESCLT = TRUE
GROUP BY cat.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY cat.DSPLY_NM

SELECT
    c.dsply_nm AS channel_name,
    SUM(t.fee_amt) AS total_fees
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL c
    ON t.CHNL_K = c.CHNL_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
    ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY c.dsply_nm
ORDER BY c.dsply_nm;

SELECT SUM(TXN_AMT) AS total_fraud_dispute_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT
WHERE DSPT_RSN_CD1 = 'FRAUD'
  AND BUS_DT_K >= 20250101
  AND BUS_DT_K <= 20251231

SELECT
    j.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction_name,
    COUNT(*) AS alert_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR j ON f.JUR_K = j.JUR_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND f.ALRT_SVRTY_CD1 = 'HIGH'
GROUP BY j.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY alert_count DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS loans_more_than_90_days_past_due
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D
WHERE BUS_DT_K = 20250831
  AND DYS_PST_DUE > 90

SELECT
  d.CAL_YR_NBR AS txn_year,
  COUNT(*) AS txn_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON d.DT_K = f.BUS_DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL c ON c.CHNL_K = f.CHNL_K
WHERE c.DSPLY_NM = 'Mobile App'
  AND c.IS_CURR = true
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR IN (2024, 2025)
GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR
ORDER BY d.CAL_YR_NBR;

SELECT 
    dp.DSPLY_NM AS loan_product_name,
    SUM(fb.OTSTN_PRNCP_AMT) AS total_outstanding_principal
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_BAL_D fb
JOIN bank_dwh.D_LN_PRD dp
    ON fb.LN_PRD_K = dp.LN_PRD_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt
    ON fb.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_DT = '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY dp.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY total_outstanding_principal DESC;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.BUS_ID) AS distinct_customers
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF w
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c
  ON w.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
  ON w.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE c.IS_CURR = TRUE
  AND c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 = 'SME'
  AND w.IS_CRSS_BRDR = TRUE
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025

WITH branch_txn AS (
    SELECT b.RGN_CD1,
           b.BUS_ID,
           b.DSPLY_NM,
           COUNT(*) as txn_count
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR b ON f.BR_K = b.BR_K
    WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    GROUP BY b.RGN_CD1, b.BUS_ID, b.DSPLY_NM
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT RGN_CD1,
           BUS_ID,
           DSPLY_NM,
           txn_count,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY RGN_CD1 ORDER BY txn_count DESC) as rn
    FROM branch_txn
)
SELECT RGN_CD1,
       DSPLY_NM AS branch_name,
       BUS_ID AS branch_number,
       txn_count
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY RGN_CD1

WITH auth_2025 AS (
    SELECT
        fa.MRCH_K,
        fa.ORGNL_AMT
    FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH fa
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dd ON fa.BUS_DT_K = dd.DT_K
    WHERE dd.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
      AND fa.ORGNL_AMT IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    dm.MRCH_CTG_CD1 AS merchant_category_code,
    SUM(a.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_authorization_amount
FROM auth_2025 a
JOIN bank_dwh.D_MRCH dm ON a.MRCH_K = dm.MRCH_K
WHERE dm.IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY dm.MRCH_CTG_CD1
ORDER BY total_authorization_amount DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT c.BUS_ID, SUM(f.AMT::NUMERIC) AS total_wire_transfer_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON f.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND c.IS_CURR = true
GROUP BY c.BUS_ID
ORDER BY total_wire_transfer_amount DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT
    f.CCY_CD1 AS currency_code,
    SUM(f.AMT::NUMERIC) AS total_wire_transfer_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY f.CCY_CD1
ORDER BY f.CCY_CD1;

WITH wire_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT f.CUST_K
    FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
      AND f.CUST_K IS NOT NULL
),
atm_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT f.CUST_K
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
      AND f.CUST_K IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM wire_customers w
JOIN atm_customers a ON w.CUST_K = a.CUST_K

SELECT COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025

SELECT
  D.CAL_YR_NBR AS year,
  COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF F
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT D ON F.BUS_DT_K = D.DT_K
WHERE D.CAL_YR_NBR IN (2024, 2025)
GROUP BY D.CAL_YR_NBR
ORDER BY D.CAL_YR_NBR

SELECT
  f.STLM_CCY_CD1 AS currency,
  SUM(f.STLM_AMT) AS total_volume
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY f.STLM_CCY_CD1
ORDER BY total_volume DESC;

SELECT
  ch.DSPLY_NM AS channel_name,
  COUNT(*) AS txn_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL ch ON f.CHNL_K = ch.CHNL_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY ch.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY txn_count DESC

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS active_customers
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE IS_CURR = true
  AND IS_ACTV = true

SELECT
    j.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction_name,
    COUNT(*) AS alert_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR j ON f.JUR_K = j.JUR_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND j.IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY j.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY alert_count DESC

SELECT
  b.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name,
  COUNT(*) AS atm_txn_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR b ON f.BR_K = b.BR_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND b.IS_CURR = true
GROUP BY b.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY atm_txn_count DESC;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS dispute_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT dcq.BUS_ID) AS num_clients_in_default
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D dlq
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST dcq
  ON dlq.CUST_K = dcq.CUST_K
WHERE dlq.BUS_DT_K = 20250831
  AND dlq.DFLT_FLG = TRUE
  AND dcq.IS_CURR = TRUE

SELECT
  ctg.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category,
  COUNT(*) AS complaint_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG ctg ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = ctg.CMPLT_CTG_K
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d.CAL_DT) = 2025
GROUP BY ctg.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY complaint_count DESC

SELECT
  d.CAL_YR_NBR,
  d.MTH_NBR,
  d.MTH_NM,
  fx.CCY_CD1,
  AVG(fx.AVRG_RT) AS avg_daily_fx_rate
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D fx
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON fx.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY
  d.CAL_YR_NBR,
  d.MTH_NBR,
  d.MTH_NM,
  fx.CCY_CD1
ORDER BY
  d.CAL_YR_NBR,
  d.MTH_NBR,
  fx.CCY_CD1;

SELECT
  m.DSPLY_NM AS market_name,
  d.CAL_YR_NBR,
  d.MTH_NBR,
  d.MTH_NM,
  SUM(f.MKT_VAL1_AMT) AS total_portfolio_valuation
FROM bank_dwh.F_PTF_VAL_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_MKT m ON f.MKT_K = m.MKT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY
  m.DSPLY_NM,
  d.CAL_YR_NBR,
  d.MTH_NBR,
  d.MTH_NM
ORDER BY
  d.CAL_YR_NBR,
  d.MTH_NBR,
  m.DSPLY_NM

SELECT ACCT_TYP_CD1, COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS account_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_ACCT
WHERE IS_CURR = true
  AND OPND_DT >= '2025-01-01'
  AND OPND_DT < '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY ACCT_TYP_CD1
ORDER BY ACCT_TYP_CD1

SELECT b.CTY_NM AS branch_city, COUNT(*) AS atm_txn_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR b ON f.BR_K = b.BR_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND d.QTR_NBR = 1
  AND b.IS_CURR = true
GROUP BY b.CTY_NM
ORDER BY b.CTY_NM

SELECT
  AVG(f.MID_RT) AS avg_mid_rate
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE f.CCY_CD1 = 'USD'
  AND d.MTH_NBR = 12
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025

SELECT
  d.MTH_NBR,
  COUNT(*) AS dispute_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR
ORDER BY d.MTH_NBR

SELECT
    CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS customer_segment,
    COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE IS_CURR = true
GROUP BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1
ORDER BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.BUS_ID) AS customers_with_no_transactions_2025
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST c
WHERE c.IS_CURR = true
  AND c.BUS_ID NOT IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT f.CUST_K::VARCHAR
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
      AND f.CUST_K IS NOT NULL
  )

SELECT
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN fa.PMT_STS_CD1 = 'DECLINED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS declined_pct
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH fa
WHERE fa.BUS_DT_K >= 20250101
  AND fa.BUS_DT_K <= 20251231;

SELECT
    cat.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category_name,
    COUNT(*) AS escalated_complaints
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG cat ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = cat.CMPLT_CTG_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND f.IS_ESCLT = TRUE
GROUP BY cat.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY escalated_complaints DESC

SELECT
    c.dsply_nm AS channel_name,
    SUM(t.fee_amt) AS total_fees
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL c
    ON t.chnl_k = c.chnl_k
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
    ON t.bus_dt_k = d.dt_k
WHERE d.cal_yr_nbr = 2025
GROUP BY c.dsply_nm
ORDER BY c.dsply_nm;

SELECT SUM(TXN_AMT) AS total_fraud_dispute_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT
WHERE DSPT_RSN_CD1 = 'FRAUD'
  AND BUS_DT_K >= 20250101
  AND BUS_DT_K <= 20251231;

SELECT
  j.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction_name,
  COUNT(*) AS alert_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT a
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR j
  ON a.JUR_K = j.JUR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
  ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE a.ALRT_SVRTY_CD1 = 'HIGH'
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY j.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY j.DSPLY_NM;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS loans_more_than_90_days_past_due
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D
WHERE BUS_DT_K = 20250831
  AND DYS_PST_DUE > 90;

SELECT 
  d_bus_dt.CAL_YR_NBR AS txn_year,
  COUNT(*) AS txn_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d_bus_dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = d_bus_dt.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL chnl ON f.CHNL_K = chnl.CHNL_K
WHERE chnl.IS_CURR = true
  AND chnl.DSPLY_NM = 'Mobile App'
  AND d_bus_dt.CAL_YR_NBR IN (2024, 2025)
GROUP BY d_bus_dt.CAL_YR_NBR
ORDER BY txn_year;

SELECT 
    dp.DSPLY_NM AS loan_product_name,
    SUM(fb.OTSTN_PRNCP_AMT) AS total_outstanding_principal
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_BAL_D fb
JOIN bank_dwh.D_LN_PRD dp
    ON fb.LN_PRD_K = dp.LN_PRD_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt
    ON fb.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_DT = '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY dp.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY total_outstanding_principal DESC;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT dc.bus_id) AS distinct_customers
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.bus_dt_k = d.dt_k
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST dc ON f.cust_k = dc.cust_k
WHERE f.is_crss_brdr = true
  AND d.cal_yr_nbr = 2025
  AND dc.cust_sgmnt_cd1 = 'SME'
  AND dc.is_curr = true
;

WITH branch_txn AS (
    SELECT br.RGN_CD1,
           br.BUS_ID,
           br.DSPLY_NM,
           COUNT(*) as txn_count,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY br.RGN_CD1 ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) as rn
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR br ON f.BR_K = br.BR_K
    WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    GROUP BY br.RGN_CD1, br.BUS_ID, br.DSPLY_NM
)
SELECT RGN_CD1,
       BUS_ID,
       DSPLY_NM,
       txn_count
FROM branch_txn
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY RGN_CD1

SELECT
  m.MRCH_CTG_CD1 AS merchant_category_code,
  SUM(fa.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_authorization_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH fa
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON fa.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_MRCH m ON fa.MRCH_K = m.MRCH_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND fa.ORGNL_AMT IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY m.MRCH_CTG_CD1
ORDER BY total_authorization_amount DESC
LIMIT 3

SELECT d.BUS_ID, SUM(f.AMT::NUMERIC) AS total_wire_transfer_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST d ON f.CUST_K = d.CUST_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND d.IS_CURR = true
GROUP BY d.BUS_ID
ORDER BY total_wire_transfer_amount DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT
  f.CCY_CD1,
  SUM(f.AMT::NUMERIC) AS total_wire_transfer_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY f.CCY_CD1
ORDER BY total_wire_transfer_amount DESC

WITH wire_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT wt.CUST_K
    FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF wt
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON wt.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
    WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
      AND wt.CUST_K IS NOT NULL
),
atm_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT at.CUST_K
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN at
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON at.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
    WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
      AND at.CUST_K IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM wire_customers w
INNER JOIN atm_customers a ON w.CUST_K = a.CUST_K

SELECT COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025

SELECT
  D.CAL_YR_NBR AS year,
  COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF W
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT D ON W.BUS_DT_K = D.DT_K
WHERE D.CAL_YR_NBR IN (2024, 2025)
GROUP BY D.CAL_YR_NBR
ORDER BY D.CAL_YR_NBR

SELECT
  f.STLM_CCY_CD1 AS currency,
  SUM(f.STLM_AMT) AS total_volume
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY f.STLM_CCY_CD1
ORDER BY total_volume DESC;

SELECT
  ch.DSPLY_NM AS channel_name,
  COUNT(*) AS txn_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL ch ON f.CHNL_K = ch.CHNL_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY ch.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY txn_count DESC

SELECT 
    COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS active_customers
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE IS_CURR = true
  AND IS_ACTV = true

SELECT 
    j.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction_name,
    COUNT(*) AS alert_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR j ON f.JUR_K = j.JUR_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY j.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY alert_count DESC

SELECT
  d.CAL_YR_NBR,
  d.MTH_NBR,
  d.MTH_NM,
  br.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name,
  COUNT(*) AS atm_txn_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR br ON f.BR_K = br.BR_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND br.IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR, d.MTH_NBR, d.MTH_NM, br.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY d.CAL_YR_NBR, d.MTH_NBR, br.DSPLY_NM

SELECT COUNT(*) AS dispute_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.CUST_K) AS num_clients_in_default
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST d ON f.CUST_K = d.CUST_K
WHERE dt.CAL_DT = '2025-08-31'
  AND f.DFLT_FLG = TRUE

SELECT
  dc.dsply_nm AS complaint_category,
  COUNT(*) AS complaint_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT fc
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dd ON fc.bus_dt_k = dd.dt_k
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG dc ON fc.cmplt_ctg_k = dc.cmplt_ctg_k
WHERE dd.cal_yr_nbr = 2025
GROUP BY dc.dsply_nm
ORDER BY complaint_count DESC;

SELECT
  f.CCY_CD1,
  AVG(f.AVRG_RT) AS avg_daily_fx_rate
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY f.CCY_CD1
ORDER BY f.CCY_CD1

SELECT ACCT_TYP_CD1, COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS account_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_ACCT
WHERE IS_CURR = true
  AND OPND_DT >= '2025-01-01'
  AND OPND_DT < '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY ACCT_TYP_CD1
ORDER BY ACCT_TYP_CD1;

SELECT
    d.CAL_YR_NBR,
    d.QTR_NBR,
    b.CTY_NM,
    COUNT(*) AS txn_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR b ON f.BR_K = b.BR_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND d.QTR_NBR = 1
GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR, d.QTR_NBR, b.CTY_NM
ORDER BY b.CTY_NM

SELECT
  AVG(f.CLSNG_BAL_AMT) AS avg_closing_balance
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f
WHERE f.BUS_DT_K = 20250630;

SELECT
  AVG(f.MID_RT) AS avg_mid_rate
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE f.CCY_CD1 = 'USD'
  AND d.MTH_NBR = 12
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025

SELECT
  d.MTH_NBR AS month_number,
  COUNT(*) AS dispute_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR
ORDER BY d.MTH_NBR;

SELECT
    CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS customer_segment,
    COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE IS_CURR = true
GROUP BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1
ORDER BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1

WITH cust_all AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.BUS_ID
    FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST c
    WHERE c.IS_CURR = true
),
cust_with_txn_2025 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT t.CUST_K
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d_txn
      ON t.BUS_DT_K = d_txn.DT_K
    WHERE d_txn.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers_with_no_account_txn_in_2025
FROM cust_all ca
LEFT JOIN cust_with_txn_2025 twt
  ON ca.BUS_ID = (SELECT c2.BUS_ID FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST c2 WHERE c2.CUST_K = twt.CUST_K AND c2.IS_CURR = true)
WHERE twt.CUST_K IS NULL;

SELECT 
  ROUND(
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE PMT_STS_CD1 = 'DECLINED')::NUMERIC * 100.0 / COUNT(*),
    2
  ) AS declined_percentage
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH
WHERE BUS_DT_K >= 20250101
  AND BUS_DT_K <= 20251231;

SELECT
    cat.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category_name,
    COUNT(*) AS escalated_complaints
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG cat ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = cat.CMPLT_CTG_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND f.IS_ESCLT = TRUE
GROUP BY cat.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY cat.DSPLY_NM

SELECT
  c.DSPLY_NM AS channel_name,
  SUM(f.FEE_AMT) AS total_fees
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL c ON f.CHNL_K = c.CHNL_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND c.IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY c.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY c.DSPLY_NM

SELECT SUM(TXN_AMT) AS total_fraud_dispute_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT
WHERE DSPT_RSN_CD1 = 'FRAUD'
  AND BUS_DT_K >= 20250101
  AND BUS_DT_K <= 20251231;

SELECT
  j.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction_name,
  COUNT(*) AS alert_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR j ON f.JUR_K = j.JUR_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND f.ALRT_SVRTY_CD1 = 'HIGH'
GROUP BY j.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY j.DSPLY_NM

SELECT COUNT(*) AS loans_more_than_90_days_past_due
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D
WHERE BUS_DT_K = 20250831
  AND DYS_PST_DUE > 90;

SELECT
    d.CAL_YR_NBR AS year,
    COUNT(*) AS txn_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL c ON f.CHNL_K = c.CHNL_K
WHERE c.DSPLY_NM = 'Mobile App'
  AND c.IS_CURR = true
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR IN (2024, 2025)
GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR
ORDER BY d.CAL_YR_NBR;

SELECT 
    lp.DSPLY_NM AS loan_product_name,
    SUM(f.OTSTN_PRNCP_AMT) AS total_outstanding_principal
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_BAL_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_LN_PRD lp ON f.LN_PRD_K = lp.LN_PRD_K
WHERE f.BUS_DT_K = 20251231
GROUP BY lp.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY total_outstanding_principal DESC;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.BUS_ID) AS distinct_customers
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF w
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON w.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON w.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
WHERE w.IS_CRSS_BRDR = true
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 = 'SME'
  AND c.IS_CURR = true

WITH branch_txn AS (
  SELECT br.RGN_CD1 AS region_code,
         br.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name,
         br.BUS_ID AS branch_id,
         COUNT(*) AS txn_count
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR br ON f.BR_K = br.BR_K
  WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  GROUP BY br.RGN_CD1, br.DSPLY_NM, br.BUS_ID
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT region_code,
         branch_name,
         branch_id,
         txn_count,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY region_code ORDER BY txn_count DESC) AS rn
  FROM branch_txn
)
SELECT region_code,
       branch_name,
       txn_count
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY region_code

WITH auth_2025 AS (
    SELECT
        fa.MRCH_K,
        fa.ORGNL_AMT
    FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH fa
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON fa.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
    WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    AND fa.ORGNL_AMT IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    dm.MRCH_CTG_CD1 AS merchant_category_code,
    SUM(a.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_authorization_amount
FROM auth_2025 a
JOIN bank_dwh.D_MRCH dm ON a.MRCH_K = dm.MRCH_K
WHERE dm.IS_CURR = true
GROUP BY dm.MRCH_CTG_CD1
ORDER BY total_authorization_amount DESC
LIMIT 3

SELECT d.BUS_ID, SUM(f.AMT::NUMERIC) AS total_wire_transfer_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST d ON f.CUST_K = d.CUST_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND d.IS_CURR = true
  AND f.CUST_K IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY d.BUS_ID
ORDER BY total_wire_transfer_amount DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT
  d.CAL_YR_NBR,
  f.CCY_CD1,
  SUM(f.AMT::NUMERIC) AS total_wire_transfer_amt
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR, f.CCY_CD1
ORDER BY d.CAL_YR_NBR, f.CCY_CD1

WITH wire_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT w.CUST_K
    FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF w
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON w.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
),
atm_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT a.CUST_K
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN a
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS distinct_customers_both
FROM wire_customers w
INNER JOIN atm_customers a ON w.CUST_K = a.CUST_K;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025

SELECT
  d.CAL_YR_NBR,
  COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR IN (2024, 2025)
GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR
ORDER BY d.CAL_YR_NBR

SELECT
    d.STLM_CCY_CD1 AS currency_code,
    SUM(f.STLM_AMT) AS total_wire_transfer_volume
FROM
    bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN
    bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE
    d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY
    d.STLM_CCY_CD1
ORDER BY
    total_wire_transfer_volume DESC;
